Short title, extent and commencement

ACT IV OF 2011
ACT IV OF 2011
BALOCHISTAN MINES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Mines Act 1923
(Act No.IV of 1923)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th May, 2011]
No. PAB/Legis
.V(04)/2011-1462, dated 20-5-2011. --The Balochistan Mines (Amendment) Bill
No.4 of 2011, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
7th May, 2011 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 18th May, 2011 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.--Whereas,
it is expedient further to amend the Mines Act, 1923 (Act No.IV of 1923) in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Balochistan Mines (Amendment) Act, 2011.
It shall extend to
the whole of Balochistan except the Tribal Areas.
It shall come into
force at once.

2. Amendment of
section 30-A, Act No.IV of 1923.---In
the Mines Act, 1923 (Act No.IV of 1923), hereinafter referred as the said Act
in section 30-A, in clause (d), for the words "duty of excise" the
words "duty of Safety/Rescue/Training" and for the words "three
paisa" the words "five rupees" shall be substituted.
